svg.title: PQ residual codebook training and vector encoding
svg.desc: Reference configuration for the 1.4B pre-training library: from the 100M sampled vectors, 2M are used for training and 0.1M held out. Residuals against the trained IVF centroids are split into 64 subspaces of 18 dimensions, and 256 codewords are trained for each. The matrix values and highlighted row on the right only illustrate the structure; each image stores 64 eight-bit codes, 64 bytes in total.

g.font-family: Arial, PingFang SC, Heiti SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
